title: fix(i18n, mcp): a translation fault serves untranslated text; ?locale= reaches MCP labels and dataset sentences
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDxdrYJq965rUfrZBso8FS3)_
Fixes #34993
Fixes #35083
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：翻译服务读取出错时，AI 问数（数据集列表、数据集查询）、对象工具和元数据接口改为返回未翻译的原文，不再清空目录或报错；其中只有数据集列表会直接告诉客户端「翻译出错」（partial + warning），数据集查询、对象工具和元数据接口只在服务器日志记一行（客户端提示另立 #35707）；AI 客户端用网址参数指定语言时，标签和说明句统一为同一种语言。
- 为什么做：属于「AI 问数」专题，解决中文租户的 AI 客户端在翻译故障时整批查询失败、以及同一回答中英混杂的问题。
- 出错会怎样：最坏情况是界面或 AI 回答显示原文标签而非译文，数据本身不受影响；改动可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

**Commit 1 (translation fault).** `translationBundleOf` (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`) now catches a throwing `getLocales` / `getTranslations`: it answers no bundle (text served untranslated, exactly as a deployment with no bundle), logs one `warn` line, and hands the same sentence to an optional `MetaListTranslationSources.reportTranslationFault`. Every caller gets it once: REST `/meta` list and by-name (was 500), the meta-types and form translations, both MCP object tool paths, and both dataset loaders. The two dataset loaders return `{ items, warning }` (the existing `DatasetToolSource` object form, without `partial`); the executor carries that `warning` on `list_datasets` (with `partial: true`, the pair the spec declares) and does not fail `query_dataset` closed on it.

**Commit 2 (`?locale=`).** `metaTranslationSources` and the app-docs locale in `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` read the request query as well as its headers (`mcpRequestHttp`: the host's parsed `query`, else the URL's). `DatasetToolsDeps` gains an optional `translationLocale`, the locale `loadDatasets` translated for; the executor reads labels and composes `nextStep` / `sourceLine` in it first. Both transports pass it.

**Commit 3.** Test-only: module-top `@objectstack/objectql` import in the new REST pin (`check:test-source-alias`).

**Pins flipped in place (#34876, seat ruling A, now ruled B by #34993):**
- `packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.dataset-locale.test.ts` and `packages/runtime/src/mcp-dataset-tools-bridge.test.ts`: `list_datasets` on a throwing i18n read was `datasets: []` + `partial` + "could not be read" warning; now the dataset in its authored label + `partial: true` + the i18n error in `warning`. `query_dataset` was 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`; now it answers (rowCount 1, authored provenance label).

**New pins:** REST `/meta` list and by-name answer 200 untranslated and log the fault (`packages/rest/src/meta-translation-fault-34993.test.ts`); the stdio object tools serve the authored labels on the fault; `?locale=zh-CN` with no `Accept-Language` answers labels, `nextStep` and `sourceLine` equal to an `Accept-Language: zh-CN` caller's (HTTP); a header-less stdio call answers `nextStep` / `sourceLine` equal to a zh-CN principal's when the labels are zh-CN.

Read first (by risk): `translationBundleOf` in `meta-item-read-gate.ts` (the catch that every `/meta` caller now goes through); `answerLocales` in `dataset-tools.ts` (the translation locale outranks the caller's own locale for sentences); `mcpRequestHttp` in `runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/mcp-dataset-tools-bridge.test.ts` — expect 12 passed, including the `?locale=` case.

## Acceptance notes

- **No client-visible warning channel on two surfaces.** REST `/meta` and the MCP object tools (`list_objects`, `describe_object`) have no envelope key for a warning on a whole answer, and the tool layer (`mcp-http-tools.ts`) is outside this claim's file surface; so they serve untranslated text and the warning goes to the server log only. `query_dataset`'s `warning` is declared "present exactly when `delegationNarrowed`", so it carries no translation warning either. No envelope key was invented. **Named follow-up (boundary flag): #35707** (review follow-ups of this PR, filed before merge so closing #34993 rests on a recorded scope cut): a client-visible whole-answer warning slot for REST `/meta`, the MCP object tools and `query_dataset` changes the contract shape, so it is out of this PR; `list_datasets` already carries the warning.
- **`list_datasets` says `partial: true` on a translation fault.** The spec pairs `warning` with `partial`; the catalogue is whole but its label matching may miss, which is what `partial` warns the model about.
- **Sentence locale on stdio follows the labels.** A stdio principal with its own `locale` now gets sentences in the i18n default when the labels are in it (the labels never followed the principal's locale on stdio).
- `translationBundleOf` is also reached by the `/meta` types and form translations in `rest-server.ts`; they now degrade the same way rather than throwing.
- Commits carry no card trailer; the PR body declares the cards.
